set.tovw: Grade F (treasure thread): found in 1906 by the estate; look-only history marker
set.pl: His farm in the Town of Anderson (sec 1 T37N R19W), with a cabin in the Town of Grantsburg (sec 32 T38N R18W)
pinev: Burnett Co probate case 110 (inventory 21 May 1906) describes his farm in sec 1 T37N R19W, Town of Anderson, where most of the money was; pin on that section (about 800 m). Pin conf B (probate land description).
set.t: Found in 1906 by the estate. History marker only; private land.

tw-bjornaa-grantsburg-1906.st: The administrator found it: the probate inventory of 21 May 1906 lists $1,257.03 in cash hidden about his places, including $30 in a small tin box under the stove, $70 in a trunk upstairs, $675 in a small blue trunk in the granary and $472 in another box. The estate was paid out to the heirs in Dec 1906.
src: Burnett Co WI probate case 110 (Wisconsin Wills and Probate, Ancestry), inventory 21 May 1906; research/ancestry/bjornaa-grantsburg-burnett.md

set.pl: E half of sec. 2, Lizard Twp (T90N R31W), Pocahontas County: the 1856 Calligan family claim on Lizard Creek (1904 county history). The 1930 Lizard Twp plat (Hixson) shows the only Calligan land then in the township as an 80 in sec 11, just south of the 1856 claim in sec 2. The 1935 'old Calligan farm' could be either, so the pin covers both.
pinev: Pin on the E half of sec. 2 T90N R31W, the Calligan family claim of 1856-58 per the 1904 county history; the 1930s owner is not yet checked against a plat (about 500 m). The 1930 Lizard Twp plat (Hixson) shows the only Calligan land then in the township as an 80 in sec 11, just south of the 1856 claim in sec 2. The 1935 'old Calligan farm' could be either, so the pin covers both. Pin widened to r1.2 km.

src: Plat Book of Pocahontas Co 1930, Lizard Twp (UIowa Digital Library node/193529)
